service.description: A sprint's burndown and numbers (SprintDetail, the sprint report, get#SprintVelocity). committed: the size of the items in it when it started (for a planned sprint, of those in it now); added and removed: the size of the items put in or taken out after the start (scopeChangeList: each change with the item, when and by whom, from the audit rows TaskServices.set#TaskSprint writes); completed: the size of its items done when it completed (else now); remaining: what is left of its items not done; carriedOver: the size of the items still open when it completed, which went to another sprint or the backlog. dayList (withDays): a first point at the start, then one per day from the start day through the end day (or the completion day when later) with the remaining work at the end of that day (null for a day still to come) and the ideal line from the remaining at the start down to 0 on the end day by working days (Monday to Friday). daysLeft: the working days from today through the end day while in progress. itemList: each item it has had, with its size and what became of it.

The velocity of a project's last sprints (sprintCount, the latest first; the sprint report, SprintDetail): each completed sprint's committed, added, removed, completed and carried-over size in the project's estimate unit (get#SprintBurndown), with the active ones too when includeActive; averageCompleted over the completed ones. A sprint whose numbers fail is logged and left out. Nothing for a user who does not see the project or is a client contact (impl-projects.md F111).

What the reports may read for the current user: the projects (allProjects for ADMIN, else visibleProjectIds, managedProjectIds and restrictedItemIds of get#VisibleProjectInfo), whose time (seesAllTime for ADMIN and, when the user's timesheet policy has approvers any, TIMESHEET_APPROVE holders; else timePartyIds: the user and those the user is the line manager of, PrtManager, beside the time on managedProjectIds) and money (moneyShown: ADMIN or TIME_ENTRY_RATE).

Time by up to three criteria and a period (design-projects.md §11 TimeReport, §3 Home's Hours by project). The entries whose fromDate is from fromDate through thruDate (days in the user's time zone; default the last four weeks to today) that the user may see (get#ReportScope: the user's own and their reports' time, the time on the projects they manage, everyone's for ADMIN and an any-approver; always within the projects the user sees, time on no project only by the person rule), narrowed by rootWorkEffortId (the project and its items), workEffortId (an item and its subtree), partyId, workTypeEnumId, clientPartyId (the entry's client, else its project's Customer) and billable (Y or N: rate type not RatpNoCharge, or it).
criteria (a list or comma text, in order, at most three; default project) of project, topItem (the item's top-level ancestor; the project itself for time on the project), parent (the item's parent), workItem, person, workType, client, billable. period: week (Monday weeks), month or none.
periodList [{key, label, fromDay, thruDay}]; rowList, one per combination of the criteria, sorted by their labels: {key, values [{criterion, id, label}], periodHours (hours of each period in order), hours, billableHours, nonBillableHours, and amount (the billable hours at the client rate: the entry's clientHourRate, else its RateAmount's; to the cent per entry) when amountsShown}; totals {periodHours, hours, billableHours, nonBillableHours, entryCount, amount, missingRateCount, currencyUomId, mixedCurrency}; chart {labels (the periods), series [{name, data}] by the first criterion (the eight largest, the rest as Other)}. amountsShown: withAmounts and the user manages money. An item the user may not see (Restricted or Confidential, not theirs, of a project they do not manage) is labeled Restricted item. truncated when more than 50000 entries matched (the first 50000 counted).

Work item counts (design-projects.md §11 WorkItemReport) over the work items (WetTask) the user may see (get#VisibleProjectInfo: of the projects the user sees, a Restricted or Confidential one only for its parties and its project's managers; template projects left out), narrowed by rootWorkEffortId or rootWorkEffortIds and purposeEnumId (the type). The period is fromDate through thruDate (days in the user's time zone; default the last twelve weeks to today).
counts: open (not Complete, Closed or Cancelled, now), created (made in the period: the first audit row of its statusId, else its first party's fromDate), resolved (first reaching Complete or Closed in the period, by the audit log of statusId, else its actualCompletionDate), overdue (open and due, estimatedCompletionDate, before today). weekList [{weekStart, label, created, resolved}] by Monday weeks of the period. openByStatus and openByType [{id, label, count}].
rowList by groupBy (status, type, assignee: each assignee of the item, Unassigned when none; priority; component; project): {groupId, groupLabel, statusCounts {statusId: count}, total, open, overdue, resolved (in the period), averageCycleDays}, the counts over every item of the scope by its status now; statusList [{statusId, label}] the statuses in the rows, in flow order; totals the same over all. Cycle time is the days from first entering In Progress to first reaching Complete or Closed (the audit log of statusId), averaged over the items resolved in the period that went through In Progress (averageCycleDays in totals). Each measure is computed on its own; one that fails is logged and left empty.

Every project's status (design-projects.md §11 PortfolioReport): the projects the user sees (template projects left out), by default those not Closed or Cancelled (statusId: a comma list of statuses instead, or all), narrowed by managerPartyId (a current ProjectManager or Manager), clientPartyId (a current Customer or CustomerBillTo) and parentWorkEffortId (the program: its sub-projects, and itself).
projectList, by name, each on its own (one that fails is logged and left out): workEffortId, workEffortName, statusId, statusLabel, healthEnumId, healthLabel, managerNames, clientName, parentWorkEffortId and parentName; the work: estimatedHours, actualHours, remainingHours, percentComplete ((estimate less remaining) over the estimate, 0 to 100; null with no estimate), hoursBudget (totalTimeAllowed), hoursUsedPercent (actual over the hours budget); the schedule: targetDate (the project's estimatedCompletionDate, a day), forecastDate (the latest due date of its open items), late (the forecast after the target), openCount, overdueCount (open items due before today); the warnings of get#ProjectStats: overEstimate (actual and remaining past the estimate, only with an estimate), overHours (past the hours budget), atRisk (health At risk or Off track, a warning or danger of get#ProjectStats, or late). With money (moneyShown: ADMIN or TIME_ENTRY_RATE) also clientBudget (totalClientCostAllowed), actualClientCost and budgetUsedPercent (actual client cost over the client budget, §11), overBudget. totals: projectCount, atRiskCount, lateCount, openCount, overdueCount, estimatedHours, actualHours, remainingHours, hoursBudget.

The money of each project (design-projects.md §11 ProfitabilityReport), for those who manage money (ADMIN and holders of TIME_ENTRY_RATE; anyone else gets an error), over the projects they see (template projects left out), narrowed by rootWorkEffortId and clientPartyId (the project's current Customer or CustomerBillTo); the time and invoices from fromDate through thruDate (days in the user's time zone; none: all of them).
The measures of §11, each per project from its time entries (on the project and its items) and invoices (WorkEffortInvoice and those of its time): cost is the hours at the workers' rates (the entry's vendorHourRate, else its vendor RateAmount; costMissingCount the entries with neither) plus expenses (the project's expense invoices: not to the client, not from the vendor, not cancelled, by invoice date); billableValue is the billable hours (rate type not RatpNoCharge) at the client rates (clientHourRate, else the RateAmount; valueMissingCount those with neither) plus the expenses (billable through, as create#ProjectInvoiceItems bills them); billed is the client invoices (to its client, not cancelled, by invoice date); unbilled the billable time with no client invoice; margin is billableValue less cost (basis billed: billed less cost) and marginPercent margin over that value. budget is the client budget (totalClientCostAllowed) and budgetUsedPercent the actual client cost (actualClientCost, rolled up from all the time) over it, as get#ProjectMoneySummary. Amounts are rounded to the cent per entry.
projectList (each on its own: one that fails is logged and left out), by client then project: workEffortId, workEffortName, clientPartyId, clientName, currencyUomId, hours, billableHours, timeCost, expenses, cost, timeValue, billableValue, billed, unbilled, margin, marginPercent, budget, actualClientCost, budgetUsedPercent, costMissingCount, valueMissingCount. clientList: the same sums by client. totals: the sums, with currencyUomId (null and mixedCurrency when the projects are in more than one currency).

Utilization by person and week (design-projects.md §11 UtilizationReport): the people of ResourceServices.get#TeamPlan (those with a current internal role on the open projects the user sees and those allocated on them; narrowed by partyId, teamPartyId, rootWorkEffortId and roleTypeId) for weeks Monday weeks from fromDate (a day; default the eight weeks to this one). The measures of §11, each per person and week: capacity (get#PartyCapacity: working hours less holidays and leave), logged (all the person's time entries that week, on any project, as the planner counts them), billable (those of rate type not RatpNoCharge), utilization (logged over capacity, a percent) and billableUtilization (billable over capacity), with allocated (their allocated hours). A week to come has no utilization.
personList [{partyId, name, roleText, weekList [{weekStart, label, capacity, logged, billable, allocated, utilization, billableUtilization}], totals {capacity, logged, billable, allocated, utilization, billableUtilization}}]; rowList the same flat by person and week (for the table and its exports); weekList [{weekStart, label, isCurrent, capacity, logged, billable, allocated, utilization, billableUtilization}] the team's sums by week; totals over the past weeks; options of get#TeamPlan (roles, teams, projects). A person whose numbers fail is logged and left out.

A project's progress (design-projects.md §11 ProgressReport), for one who sees the project: milestoneList (get#ProjectMilestoneSummary, its totals last) and the breakdown by item: the top-level items (or, with fromWorkEffortId, that item's children; or, with parentWorkEffortId, one level under that item, as the tree fetches it) down to depth levels (1 to 6), each row with its subtree's numbers (get#WorkEffortChildStats: estimated, remaining and actual hours and days at timePerDay, the hours budget, act/est, act+rem/est, act/bgt and act+rem/bgt percents; cancelled items left out), parentWorkEffortId (empty at the first level), level (1 at the first), childCount (its children not cancelled) and the row order of a depth-first walk. A Restricted or Confidential item the user may not see is left out (its numbers stay in its parent's). The money fields of the stats (actualCost, actualClientCost, totalClientCostAllowed) are given only to those who manage money. totals: the first level's sums with their percents. Each level is computed on its own: one that fails is logged and left out.
